findings.summary: Development-only minimatch 3.1.5 (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, ReDoS via globparts amplification, fixed in 11.0.1) is used by the ESLint 9 chain. Its suggested fix is a semver-major change to a different ESLint, and overriding minimatch to 11 would change the API that ESLint 9 calls. Not exposed at runtime. No compatible fix exists yet.
findings.remediation: Track ESLint and eslint-config-next upgrades. Re-run npm audit when they release.

files.observations: Read in full. RFC 4226 HOTP and RFC 6238 step matching use constant-time comparison per candidate and a ±1 drift window. Base32 encode and decode are bounded for the 20-byte secret. AES-256-GCM uses a fresh 12-byte nonce per encryption, stores the 16-byte tag, and derives its key with HKDF from the master secret under a fixed info string. Decryption throws on tag mismatch, which is the intended failure. No finding.
